facts.fact: UCSAF's chief executive said on 5 October 2026 that the fund will build 250 ICT laboratories of 20 computers each in public schools this financial year, that it has equipped over 1,121 schools to date, and that its subsidies to telecom operators have paid for 2,166 towers in 2,306 wards; the page does not name the law that set up the fund.
